summary: A human specialist is permitted to handle any support request.
quote: A human specialist may handle every support request.

summary: Prefer assigning non-urgent, standard-sensitivity requests to the support agent when it is available.
quote: Prefer the support agent for non-urgent, standard-sensitivity requests when the agent is available.

summary: Assign urgent or restricted requests to the human specialist, and use the human specialist whenever the support agent is unavailable.
quote: Use the human specialist for urgent or restricted requests and whenever the support agent is unavailable.

summary: Internal project members are permitted to receive the full customer record.
quote: Internal project members may receive the full customer record.

summary: External partners may receive the full customer record only if explicit full-record approval has been granted.
quote: External partners may receive the full customer record only with explicit full-record approval.

summary: Authorized external partners are permitted to receive a redacted summary.
quote: Authorized external partners may receive a redacted summary.

summary: Prefer the most informative disclosure that is permitted; reject the request if no disclosure is permitted.
quote: Prefer the most informative permitted disclosure; reject the request when no disclosure is permitted.

summary: Refunds of 1000 units or less may be executed immediately.
quote: Refunds up to and including 1000 units may be executed immediately.

summary: Refunds exceeding 1000 units must receive approval before execution.
quote: Refunds above 1000 units require approval before execution.

summary: Once approved, a refund may be executed at any amount.
quote: An approved refund may be executed regardless of amount.

summary: If the refund amount is missing, request it before deciding whether to execute the refund.
quote: Request the missing amount before deciding whether to execute a refund.

summary: Accept a delivery only if its acceptance checks pass and all required evidence is complete.
quote: Accept a delivery only when its acceptance checks pass and the required evidence is complete.

summary: Request revision if either the acceptance checks or the supporting evidence are incomplete.
quote: Request revision when either acceptance checks or supporting evidence are incomplete.
